0022600041.text: The Trail Blazers (7-3, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West) are on the road against the Sacramento Kings (1-10, 14th in the West), who have lost four straight and are 0-6 at home. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (foot bruise), Ja Morant (hamstring), Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and Vit Krejci (ankle), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision. Portland leads the season series 1-0 after a 128-120 win in Sacramento on October 23, 2026, and it also won all four meetings in 2025-26.
